statement.p: For each of the following, perform the indicated operations on the vectors
\vec a = \,\mathit{\vec j}+2\,\mathit{\vec k}, \vec b = -\,\mathit{\vec i}-\,\mathit{\vec j}+3\,\mathit{\vec k}, \vec z = 2\,\mathit{\vec i}+5\,\mathit{\vec j}.

static.solution:
(a) 5 \vec a + 5 \vec b = 5 (\,\mathit{\vec j}+2\,\mathit{\vec k}) + 5 (-\,\mathit{\vec i}-\,\mathit{\vec j}+3\,\mathit{\vec k}) = -5\,\mathit{\vec i}+25\,\mathit{\vec k}.
(b) 6 \vec a + 4 \vec b - 3 \vec z = 6 (\,\mathit{\vec j}+2\,\mathit{\vec k}) + 4 (-\,\mathit{\vec i}-\,\mathit{\vec j}+3\,\mathit{\vec k}) - 3 (2\,\mathit{\vec i}+5\,\mathit{\vec j}) = -10\,\mathit{\vec i}-13\,\mathit{\vec j}+24\,\mathit{\vec k}.
